items.markdown:
![Massaman Curry Recipe – Instant Pot & Stove | Spice Cravings](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/07280251-1672-0139-0000-75dd768bc81d:6)
Massaman curry requires [Massaman Curry Paste](https://hot-thai-kitchen.com/massaman-curry/) , coconut milk, meat, and root vegetables.[](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Massaman_curry) [[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Massaman_curry)[[2]](https://grantourismotravels.com/authentic-beef-massaman-curry-recipe/)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=K0BzBW_kJog&t=45)[[4]](https://tastesbetterfromscratch.com/massaman-curry/)

Main Ingredients

- **Protein:** Bone-in chicken thighs or diced beef chuck/stewing steak (approx. 500g–1kg)
- **Liquids & Base:** 400ml to 800ml full-fat coconut milk and water or light stock
- **Vegetables:** Waxy potatoes (such as Yukon Gold) and yellow or white onions
- **Nuts:** Whole roasted peanuts
- **Flavor Balancers:** Tamarind paste, fish sauce, and palm sugar (or light brown sugar)
- **Whole Spices:** Cinnamon sticks (or cassia bark) and cardamom pods
- **Aromatics:** Bay leaves and kaffir lime leaves (optional)[](https://hot-thai-kitchen.com/massaman-curry/) [[1]](https://hot-thai-kitchen.com/massaman-curry/)[[2]](https://www.bbcgoodfood.com/recipes/beef-massaman-curry)[[3]](https://southsidekitchen.com/beef-massaman-curry/)[[4]](https://www.theguardian.com/food/2026/feb/15/perfect-massaman-recipe-felicity-cloake)[[5]](https://grantourismotravels.com/authentic-beef-massaman-curry-recipe/)[[6]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/shKuk5VUTzw)

Curry Paste Ingredients If making the paste from scratch rather than buying store-bought paste:[](https://hot-thai-kitchen.com/massaman-curry/) 

- **Dried Spices:** Cumin seeds, coriander seeds, cloves, nutmeg or mace, and ground cinnamon
- **Fresh Aromatics:** Dried red chilies, lemongrass, galangal, garlic, and Thai shallots
- **Umami:** Fermented shrimp paste (gapi) and white pepper[](https://www.theguardian.com/food/2026/feb/15/perfect-massaman-recipe-felicity-cloake) [[1]](https://www.jintanathaicuisine.com/news-articles/thai-restaurant-bowness-what-is-massaman-curry)[[2]](https://www.bbc.co.uk/food/recipes/thai_massaman_chicken_82428)

For a visual guide on how to properly reduce the coconut milk and build the rich layers of a traditional Massaman curry:![Related video thumbnail](https://encrypted-tbn2.gstatic.com/images?q=tbn:ANd9GcR2z2SFP8tJDMYmOYV_P7ku7ExWfIKx_X85CbjhP1ufo8GqzUUR)
5m[Easy One Pot Thai Massaman Curry 223k views  · 3 years ago![](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/07280251-1672-0139-0000-75dd768bc81d:7)
YouTube · Munchies](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=K0BzBW_kJog&t=45) If you'd like, let me know:

- Are you planning to make the **curry paste from scratch** or use a **store-bought brand**?
- Do you prefer to use **chicken or beef**?
